title: WikiImagesSuggestRequest
description: wiki.images-suggest-request@1: the body of wiki.images.suggest on OpenVibe.Wiki (an editor of the space). POST /api/v1/pages/:id/images/suggest asks the wiki.article.images task for the article's lead picture and figures: Wikimedia Commons and Openverse first, keeping the licence and the author; then OpenVibe.Pics and the page's own Media; an AI illustration only when nothing real exists, never of a real person. Every field is optional; the path names the article.

query.description: What to look for; defaults to the article's title and summary.

section.description: A section heading the pictures should illustrate; omitted, the lead picture is suggested first.

allow_ai.description: Whether an illustration may be drawn when no real picture exists (default true; never for an article about a real person).

choice.description: The search engine (search/commons, search/openverse, …) for the wiki.article.images task; the owner's or person's choice answers when omitted.
